interpretation: The passing test means the known limitation was reproduced as specified. A structurally healthy foreign WAL changed business data while integrity, foreign-key and migration checks remained healthy and DatabaseInitializer accepted it. It does not prove WAL provenance protection.
productDecisionRequired: Confirm that S9-T07 establishes trust at a clean, ordinary-session maintenance freeze and rejects unexplained or late sidecars from that point forward. If the requirement includes detecting a foreign WAL already replayed before that trust point, the current frozen-schema scope cannot prove it and requires a separate provenance contract.
